outcomes.message: Thistledown Farm. Aunt Wren's field is overgrown, but the soil still smells sweet.
Down by the river, the grindstone rumbles back to life. Juniper now sells moonmelon seeds!
The moonmelon is cool in your hands, and faintly, unmistakably, glowing.
The street lanterns flicker on, one by one.

quests.name: Roots in the Ground
quests.description: Aunt Wren's field has been asleep for a year. Wake it up: harvest 5 emberroot. (Till with T, plant seeds, water with Q.)

quests.name: The Silent Mill
quests.description: Bram's grindstone axle snapped. Bring him 10 wood and 5 stone so the mill can grind moonmelon seed again.

quests.name: Lantern Night
quests.description: Grow 3 moonmelons so Brambleford can light its lanterns again.

quests.name: Real Ember Stew
quests.description: Bring Marigold 4 emberroot for the Copper Kettle.

quests.name: Something's Biting
quests.description: Catch 2 carp in the river below the bridge.

item.name: Emberroot Seeds
item.description: Warm little seeds. Sprout in 3 days, spring and summer.

item.name: Hoe

item.name: Watering Can

item.name: Axe

outcomes.message: A warm green light washes over the farm…

config.prompt: Hook the fish — stop the marker in the green zone!

steps.text: Everyone! Gather round. For the first time in a year...
steps.speaker: npc-odile

steps.text: THEY'RE GLOWING. The melons are GLOWING. I'm never sleeping again.
steps.speaker: npc-pip

steps.text: Mill's grinding, lanterns are lit. Not bad for a farm that was all weeds a week ago.
steps.speaker: npc-bram

steps.text: Ember Stew for everyone! Bram, put that third bowl down.
steps.speaker: npc-marigold

steps.text: Dad would have liked this. He always said the river looks best with lights on it.
steps.speaker: npc-sela

steps.text: I'm going to need so many more moonmelon seeds.
steps.speaker: npc-juniper

steps.text: And that, friends, is a story I'll be telling on every road from here to the sea.
steps.speaker: npc-rook

steps.text: Wren would be so proud of you. Welcome home, {player}.
steps.speaker: npc-odile

steps.text: The End... of the beginning. Thank you for playing Brambleford! The farm is yours to keep growing.
Can I tell you something? See that bend? Dad's little boat sank right there.
steps.speaker: npc-sela

steps.text: Everyone laughed. He laughed loudest. Then he built another one.
steps.speaker: npc-sela

steps.text: You remind me of him a bit. You just keep planting.
steps.speaker: npc-sela

mail.subject: If you're reading this
mail.text:
My dear,

If this letter found you, then the farm is yours. Don't fuss over the weeds. Plant emberroot first, it's forgiving. And when the time is right, plant moonmelons: Brambleford has always lit its lanterns with them.

Tell Odile I said she still owes me a pie.

All my love,
Aunt Wren

mail.subject: The wheel and the stone
mail.text:
Farmer,

She grinds! First proper sack of seed meal in a year. Juniper's got the moonmelon seed. Come by for flour any time. Bring stones. I like stones.

Bram

mail.subject: IT IS MY BIRTHDAY
mail.text: Hi. It is my birthday today. That is all. Eggs are a good present. Frogs are a better present. - Pip
